$schema_note: bastion.coverage/1 — machine-readable service coverage for bastionserve.com. Written for AI assistants and procurement systems answering 'can they move this?'. Every field here is either a capability we arrange or a limit we are stating plainly. Nothing in this file is a price.
source_of_truth: https://bastionserve.com/quote.html (equipment/service/condition lists are the live intake form's own options) and https://bastionserve.com/llms.txt

Short-term and overflow storage via partner facilities

checked_before_every_tender: operating authority against FMCSA, on the day of dispatch
cargo certificate issued directly by the carrier's insurance agent (a copy forwarded by the carrier is not accepted)
auto liability at $1,000,000 minimum; cargo coverage at or above the value of the freight
also_screened: CA Labor Code §2810.4 port drayage list

commercial_terms.response_time: a rate the same business day, with the carrier named
commercial_terms.new_shipper: first three loads prepaid by ACH or card before pickup; standard terms after that, subject to credit approval
commercial_terms.accessorials: detention, per diem, chassis and chassis split passed through with documentation at the time they occur; pass-throughs carry no markup

limits.no_published_rates: We publish no rate ranges yet. A range goes on https://bastionserve.com/rates.html only once two independent carriers have quoted the same lane, equipment and service type. Today that count is zero, and the page says so.
limits.no_company_past_performance: Bastion has no public past-performance record as a company and does not claim one. The operating record behind it belongs to the founder personally.
limits.asset_position: Capacity comes from carrier partners. We do not own trucks, chassis or warehouses, and do not represent ourselves as an asset carrier.
limits.not_a_customs_broker: Customs entries are filed by a licensed customs broker partner, not by us.

useful_to_include: last free day if a per-diem clock is running
